mockups.name: 01-atlas
mockups.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity website concept screenshot for wonder, Travel in China 中国旅行图志.
Visual system: exquisite contemporary Chinese watercolor travel journal combined with clean functional map guide. Warm ivory paper #f7f3e9, dark pine ink #243e37, jade #64897d, subtle ochre accent. Spacious asymmetric editorial layout, delicate hairline rules, restrained watercolor texture. Beautiful Chinese literary serif headings, readable dark Chinese text, small tracked English labels. Flat front-facing browser-content screenshot, no perspective, no device chrome unless requested. Illustrations are watercolor and colored pencil, geographically and culturally grounded, never photographs. Realistic usable interface, visible buttons, ample whitespace. Keep primary labels legible; use sparse short Chinese text, no long fake paragraphs. Mark illustration 艺术化呈现.
Screen 1: desktop collection landing page, landscape 1536x1024 composition. Header wonder left, small 返回书架 right. Large title 中国旅行图志 with English Travel in China and short subtitle 从一碗面、一条街，读懂一个地方. Lower left two thirds: elegant accurate China provincial outline map with Taiwan, Hainan and South China Sea inset, understated pale green land, light blue sea, unobtrusive cartographic details and geographic location Chengdu pin labeled 成都. Do not fabricate dense geographic labels. Right third: elegant vertical destination sidebar with heading 想去哪里, search field 搜索目的地, category pills 全部 吃 玩 人文, one large Chengdu watercolor thumbnail of tiled tea pavilion, bamboo and tea table, text 四川 · 成都, brief teasers and button 查看预览. Tiny bottom note 从成都开始，慢慢认识中国. Consistent quiet premium travel atlas feeling.
